question: Does local spatial-neighbour temporal attention plus relative-time bias improve motion and prompt separation over the current factorised ResUNet?

shared.conditioning: frozen T5-small full prompt, CFG dropout 0.1
shared.optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-4 with existing warmup/cosine schedule

promotion_gate: continuation validation loss is no worse than 5% above the matched baseline
fixed-noise prompt changes are larger relative to fixed-prompt noise changes
walking, running, and sitting samples show more distinguishable motion without worse structural scores
the reference batch-8 configuration remains within a 24 GB memory budget
